meta.title: Souqna
meta.description: Buy and sell safely. Your money is held until you receive your item.

home.promiseTitle: Your money is safe until you receive your item
home.promiseBody: You pay us and we hold the money. The seller only gets it once the item reaches you and it's what you agreed.
home.step1: Pick an item and chat with the seller in the app.
home.step2: Pay, and we hold your money safely.
home.step3: Receive and check the item, then the money goes to the seller.
home.emptyFeed: No listings yet. Be the first to sell!

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with your mobile number. No email needed.
login.phoneHint: Example: 0912345678. Your number is never shown to anyone.
login.resendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} seconds

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.intro: Your name and city are shown to people on your listings.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Don't include a phone number or link.

account.phonePrivate: Your number is never shown to anyone.
account.signOutOthers: Log out of all other devices
account.signedOutOthers: You've been logged out of your other devices.

listing.comingSoon: Chat and protected buying arrive in the next update.
listing.safety1: Never send money outside Souqna. When you pay in the app, we hold your money until you receive the item.
listing.safety2: Don't share your phone number or address in listings or chat.
listing.safety3: If a listing looks suspicious, report it.

prohibited.title: What you can't sell on Souqna
prohibited.intro: To keep people safe, these items may not be sold on Souqna. Listings with them are removed, and accounts may be suspended.
prohibited.weapons: Weapons, ammunition and anything like them
prohibited.documents: Official documents: passports, national ID numbers, ID cards
prohibited.review: Some listings are reviewed by a person before they go live.
